body:
Card layout now has six-dot drag handles and per-card eye controls. Section visibility is stored on the card and loads on every device; hiding retains content and unfinished entries. Browser-local section order remains separate.

The final full gate passes 257 Rust, 139 JavaScript and 12 Python tests. Six Chromium and four WebKit suites plus broad HTTPS/planning checks pass, including touch cancellation, narrow-screen layouts, shared visibility, hidden draft retention and all-hidden recovery.

The rebuilt manual app is available at the existing HTTPS address. Restart preserves all 49 prior resource versions, two pins, preferences and certificate; all 33 served build files match. Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-card-layout-controls.md. Physical-device and full release acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: Card layout drag handles and shared section visibility verified
